run_convert_hf_checkpoint: run the script to convert a HuggingFace MapAnything model checkpoint to benchmark-compatible format
run_convert_apache_checkpoint: run the script with the --apache flag to convert the Apache 2.0 licensed MapAnything model
run_convert_specific_device: run the script with --device cuda to convert a HuggingFace checkpoint using a specific device
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for model name, output path, device, and apache flag
review_main_checkpoint_flow: review the main function that loads a model, extracts the state dict, saves the checkpoint, and verifies it
